name: std-rich-editor
description: std-rich-editor — wiki/CMS Notion-style block editor. Browses documents in `browsing`; opens the rich-block-editor on a selected row; persists block edits + publish status. `BlockEdit` is a rebindable single-row IN-PLACE body editor: an organism embeds it where the content belongs, rebinds it to its own entity (WikiPage, Note, …), hands it the row's id + blocksJson via OPEN, and routes the emitted BLOCKS_SAVED into its own persistor — this atom never fetches or persists. The read-only body is itself the edit affordance; an empty row paints an empty state that starts the first block; and OPEN_DRAFT opens straight into the authoring editor for a row that was just minted blank (document-first creation).

events.name: Open
events.description: Hands the editor the row whose body it renders — the caller supplies the row's id and current blocks, since this trait never fetches them itself. Re-firing it repaints the body (e.g. after the host refetches a saved row).

events.name: Open Draft
events.description: Hands the editor a row that was just created as a blank draft: same payload as OPEN, but the body opens straight in the authoring editor instead of the read-only render, so a document-first 'New page' lands the author on a cursor rather than an empty state.
events.synonyms: new document, start writing, blank draft, compose
